title: Power Management doesn't fall back to normal sleep if Sleep-then-hibernate set, and then hibernate is disabled
line: With sleep then hibernate or hybrid sleep chosen but no longer available, closing the lid or pressing the power or Sleep key now puts the computer to sleep instead of doing nothing.
explanation: The KCM hides sleep then hibernate and hybrid sleep once the system can't do them, but the old SleepMode stays in powerdevilrc. SuspendSession then asked for those modes anyway, and libkworkspace's SessionManagement silently ignores a request logind says it can't do, so the lid, power button, Sleep key and idle sleep did nothing. The change only uses those modes when the suspend controller reports them as possible and otherwise falls back to plain sleep.

commits.message:
suspendsession: Fall back to plain sleep if the sleep mode is unavailable

With "Standby, then hibernate" or "Hybrid sleep" set but no longer possible, for
example after hibernation was disabled, the lid, power button and Sleep key did
nothing. Use plain sleep in that case instead.

BUG: 500841
BUG: 498298

media.caption: Master, sleep then hibernate set with hibernation unavailable: Sleep key, power button and lid close make no suspend call at all
With the fix, the same three actions each suspend

With the fix, plain sleep each time
